derivation: LIFE-007 separates the two clocks. Renewal eligibility uses the latest retained available lifecycle clock for the permit source, which is at the prior permit's exclusive expiry, so the result is not PREREQUISITE_MISSING. The rule then states that after retained expiry is established the new authority input is evaluated normally and its current clock may be unavailable, producing the ordinary admitted authority withholding. AUTH-005 cannot establish permission without a current clock. The lifecycle clock revision is null, which LIFE-007 permits only on an authority-withheld proposal whose selected clock is unavailable. The prior permit and reservation remain unextended and unsuperseded.
